meta.scope: places and dates only; no personal data

notes.big_venue_capacity_sum: sum of OSM capacity tags of non-university venues with capacity >= 10000 (venues without a capacity tag do not count)
notes.nearest_amtrak_km: great-circle km from the county 2020 mean centre of population (Census) to the nearest Amtrak TRAIN station (NTAD); null for AK, HI, PR and territories
notes.transit_trips_per_capita: NTD 2025 unlinked passenger trips; each agency's trips are split over the counties holding >=3 and >=1% of its GTFS stops (NTM) in proportion to county population, else by its primary UZA (2020 UA-county land x county urban density), else agency HQ county; divided by Census POPESTIMATE2025. Shares of UPT: stops 98.7%, uza 0.9%, hq 0.3%, none 0.0%
notes.walkability_median: median EPA National Walkability Index (1-20) over the county's 2019 block groups; Connecticut block groups are re-assigned to 2022+ planning regions by interior point
notes.fare_free_agency: derived: an agency headquartered (or with most stops) in the county reported $0 fare revenues earned and >=100k trips in NTD 2025; NTD does not itself publish a 'fare-free' list
notes.break_proxies: heuristic windows; no open federal school-calendar source exists
